_comment: Enforcement list for ml_pipeline/scripts/data_governance.py (docs/DATA_GOVERNANCE.md). It makes no rights decision: sources blocked or not permitted for every use in rights.json are already forbidden automatically. This file adds sources and path fragments that must never appear in a serving, export, training, evaluation or release manifest, whatever their status elsewhere. Added by engineering from existing notes in rights.json; the project owner confirms or edits it.

forbidden_sources.zomi_bethel_church_web: a website capture that holds identifiable people's personal information; nothing is permitted until the church gives written permission (rights.json)

forbidden_path_fragments.zomibethelchurch: the church website capture, same reason
